# Introducing Mimica Analyst: Ask Anything About Your Processes

Author

Share

[LinkedIn icon](https://www.mimica.ai/articles/introducing-mimica-analyst-ask-anything-about-your-processes#) [Facebook icon](https://www.mimica.ai/articles/introducing-mimica-analyst-ask-anything-about-your-processes#)

Mimica Analyst is an AI conversational interface that helps you dig deeper into your process data and uncover even more insights.

What if you could ask anything about your enterprise processes and get the answer back instantly? Mimica Analyst brings an AI conversational interface to the process data captured [across Mimica](https://www.mimica.ai/product).

Ask how work gets done, where processes vary, what slows teams down, or where the biggest opportunities for improvement are – and Analyst searches across the underlying data to surface a clear, grounded answer.

It’s a process analyst at your fingertips, already familiar with every workflow, variation, and step your team has captured.

## Ask questions. Get answers grounded in your real workflows.

Mimica Analyst doesn’t answer from assumptions about how a process should work. Its responses are grounded in the workflows your organization has actually captured in Mimica.

That means you can use Analyst to investigate the questions that come up every day:

Which process should we automate first? Where is this bottleneck actually happening? How much time does this step take? How does work vary across different teams or paths?

Instead of combing through results or building a one-off analysis, simply ask the question. Analyst does the research across your project data and brings the answer back to you.

## Visualize the answer, not just the explanation.

Some questions are best answered with context and numbers. Others need a flowchart, timeline, or diagram to make a pattern clear. So Analyst doesn't stop at text. Depending on the question, it can create rich, visual responses directly in the conversation, including::

- Tables, for laying out detailed findings clearly
- Interactive charts, for visualizing quantitative data and comparing results
- Diagrams, including sequence diagrams, timelines, mindmaps, flowcharts, treemaps, and Sankey diagrams, for showing how a process actually flows
- Formatted equations, for questions that call for mathematical analysis

Ask where volume piles up across five systems, and Analyst can hand back a Sankey diagram instead of a table you'd have to interpret yourself. Ask how long each step in a process takes, and a timeline says more than a paragraph ever could.

Analyst builds these visuals directly from your own project data and picks the format that fits the question. If you already know you want a flowchart or a sequence diagram specifically, just ask for one by name.

## Build on every answer

Mimica Analyst is designed for exploration, not one-and-done searches.  Ask a question in plain language, follow up on the answer, and keep exploring a project conversationally.

For more complex questions, multi-line prompts make it easy to provide additional instructions or context. And when Analyst surfaces something worth sharing, you can copy the response directly into a presentation, document, message, or wherever you need it next.

## Your process data has answers. Just ask.

The more process data your organization captures in Mimica, the more there is to explore.

Mimica Analyst makes that data accessible through a simple conversation, helping more people across your organization understand how work really gets done and uncover the insights hiding within it.

Start a conversation with Mimica Analyst today.
